nginx-options.header-name.help.defaultMessage: The HTTP header name to set, add, or remove. Header names are case-insensitive.

nginx-options.header-value.help.defaultMessage: The header value sent to the upstream or client. Choose approved-variable mode to use a supported Nginx variable.

nginx-options.proxy-bind.help.defaultMessage: Sets the local source IP used for upstream connections. Leave empty to let system routing choose it.

nginx-options.proxy-buffer-size.help.defaultMessage: Buffer size used for upstream response headers and the first response body chunk.

nginx-options.proxy-buffers-count.help.defaultMessage: Number of buffers allocated for the response body; configure together with the individual buffer size.

nginx-options.proxy-buffers-size.help.defaultMessage: Size of each proxy response-body buffer, for example 8k.

nginx-options.proxy-busy-buffers-size.he.defaultMessage: Total size of proxy buffers that may stay busy while the client receives the response.

nginx-options.proxy-connect-timeout.help.defaultMessage: Maximum time allowed to establish the TCP/TLS connection to the upstream.

nginx-options.proxy-force-ranges.help.defaultMessage: Allows Nginx to process Range requests for cached responses even if the upstream omits Accept-Ranges.

nginx-options.proxy-headers-hash-bucket-.defaultMessage: Hash bucket size for proxy request-header names. Change only when Nginx reports an insufficient header hash.

nginx-options.proxy-headers-hash-max-siz.defaultMessage: Maximum size of the proxy request-header hash table. Change only when Nginx reports an insufficient header hash.

nginx-options.proxy-hide-header.help.defaultMessage: Hide one or more headers from the upstream response; separate names with commas.

nginx-options.proxy-http-version.help.defaultMessage: Sets the HTTP version used between Nginx and the upstream. HTTP/1.1 is commonly needed for WebSockets and chunked transfer.

nginx-options.proxy-ignore-client-abort..defaultMessage: Continue receiving the upstream response after the client disconnects. Keep off unless there is a specific need.

nginx-options.proxy-ignore-headers.help.defaultMessage: Ignores internal control information sent by the upstream in these response headers, such as cache or internal-redirect directives.

nginx-options.proxy-intercept-errors.hel.defaultMessage: Lets Nginx handle selected error statuses instead of returning the upstream error response directly.

nginx-options.proxy-limit-rate.help.defaultMessage: Limits Nginx reads from the upstream in bytes per second. 0 means unlimited.

nginx-options.proxy-max-temp-file-size.h.defaultMessage: Maximum size of one temporary file used for a large upstream response. Set 0 to forbid temporary-file writes.

nginx-options.proxy-method.help.defaultMessage: Replaces the client request method with a fixed method. Leave it unset to preserve the original request method.

nginx-options.proxy-next-upstream-timeou.defaultMessage: Total time limit for trying another upstream after retryable failures.

nginx-options.proxy-next-upstream-tries..defaultMessage: Maximum number of upstream attempts after a retryable failure. Leave empty for the Nginx default.

nginx-options.proxy-next-upstream.help.defaultMessage: Select the failures that should make Nginx try the next upstream. Leaving all unchecked uses Nginx defaults.

nginx-options.proxy-pass-header.help.defaultMessage: Explicitly pass upstream response headers that Nginx would otherwise not pass; separate names with commas.

nginx-options.proxy-pass-request-body.he.defaultMessage: Controls whether the client request body is sent upstream. This should normally remain enabled.

nginx-options.proxy-pass-request-headers.defaultMessage: Controls whether client request headers are sent upstream. When off, only explicitly configured proxy headers are sent.

nginx-options.proxy-pass-trailers.help.defaultMessage: Controls forwarding HTTP chunked-response trailer headers. It requires a compatible HTTP/1.1 upstream.

nginx-options.proxy-read-timeout.help.defaultMessage: Maximum interval between reads from the upstream. SSE and other streaming responses usually need a longer value.

nginx-options.proxy-redirect.help.defaultMessage: Rewrites Location and Refresh redirects in upstream responses. Inherit emits no additional directive.

nginx-options.proxy-send-timeout.help.defaultMessage: Maximum interval between writes while sending request data to the upstream.

nginx-options.proxy-socket-keepalive.hel.defaultMessage: Enables operating-system TCP keepalive on connections to the upstream.

nginx-options.proxy-ssl-ciphers.help.defaultMessage: TLS cipher-suite string allowed when connecting to an HTTPS upstream.

nginx-options.proxy-ssl-name.help.defaultMessage: Server name used in the TLS handshake with an HTTPS upstream. When unset, the upstream hostname is normally used.

nginx-options.proxy-ssl-protocols.help.defaultMessage: Limits the TLS protocol versions negotiated with an HTTPS upstream.

nginx-options.proxy-ssl-session-reuse.he.defaultMessage: Reuses TLS sessions to HTTPS upstreams to reduce handshake overhead; disable it if the upstream has compatibility issues.

nginx-options.proxy-ssl-verify-depth.hel.defaultMessage: Maximum certificate-chain depth accepted when verifying the HTTPS upstream certificate.

nginx-options.proxy-ssl-verify.help.defaultMessage: When enabled, the container system CA bundle is used as proxy_ssl_trusted_certificate.

nginx-options.proxy-temp-file-write-size.defaultMessage: Size of each write to a proxy temporary file.
